translation.name: Bab dummad Jesucristoba igar mesisad garda

content: Jesús milibake-dulemar masgi oguchad
Deun dule-bukidar ambikunonibargu, Jesús dulemar-mas-gunned-suli dakargu, e-sapinganse gochad, amarga sogded:
—We-dulemar wile an daked, ar ibapaagus anmarba garmakdimalad, emide mas-gunned satemalad.
Mas-guchasuli anmar e-negse barmidele, igarba ukudba negoedmalaled, ar ade bukidar dikasur danimalad.
E-sapingan, Jesús-abin sogdemalad: —Ar wede igi anmar mas-gunned ukosunna, ar wegi dule mamaisulid. ¿Bia anmar mas dakdagosunna?
Jesús na e-sapinganse egisdesun: —¿Madu gwabigwa bemar sedisunna? E-sapingan, Jesús-abin sogdemalad: —Madu-gwagugle an sedimarye.

Degi Jesús dulemar napagi oambikued imaksad. E-argangi madu-gwagugled susgua, Bab Dummadse goted, sogded: “Dog-nued, we-madu be anmarga uksagu.” Geb degi Jesús madu biske-biske imasgu, ega merguded, geb degi e-sapinganga madu uksasunnad, adi dulemarga mimmiegar.
Aginbali, ua-burwigana ichesaar wis sedimarbalid. Jesús Bab Dummadga dog-nuedye sogsabargu, ega mergudbalid. Geb degi dulemarga mimmiega imaksabalid.
Bela nue-immeles mas guchamalad. Geb a-sorba Jesús-sapingan mas-obichad garba-gwagugle wesmalad.
Bela-dulemar-milibakesaar mas guchamalad. A-sorba Jesús dulemar e-neg-e-negse barmissunnad.
Jesúsdi na e-sapinganmala urgi nakwisgu, Dalmanuta-yalaganba nade-gusmalad.
Fariseomar ibmar-wilubgan-dakledisulid dakbimalad

Fariseomar Jesússe nonimalad, amar Jesús abin-abin imakarmalad. Amar yamo Jesús-wilubdakega ega sogdemalad: —Be anmarga Bab-Dummad-ganguedba ibmar-wilubgan-dakledisulid anmar-wagab be imake, adi anmar mag be-dakoed, be Bab-Dummad-nuggi nue danikid.

Jesús nue ulubgi bunnodgu, nue bukib-binsa sogded: —¿Ibiga we-dulemar-emiskwamalad ibmar-wilubgan-dakledisulid e-wagab imakbi an-abege? Napira an bemarga soged, bemarga an oyogosulid bemar anse ibmar egisnaid.
Degi Jesús Fariseomar-idu nade-gusad. Geb degi gannar urgi nakwisgu, mata-abin-obakar naded.
Fariseomar, degi, Herodes dulemar-odurdaked, igar-nuedsulid
Jesús-sapingan madu-seded nue-ies nade-gusmalad, unnila madu-gwagwen urgi wis sii daklealid.
Jesús na e-sapinganga sogded: —Nue salakarmar, Fariseomar, degi, Herodes madubur-inagi.
E-sapingan na muchub-muchub egisnanai-guarmalad, ar wede ibi nue obarsunna. Sogdemalad: “Anmar madu searsulidbali wede Jesús anmarga degi-soged.”
Jesús degi-e-sapingan-soge-itosgu, ega sogded: —¿Ibiga bemar madu surye sogmala? ¿Amba bemar nue aku-itomala, magar gwen itosurmala an-bemarga-sogsad? ¿Amba be nono-seredmala?
Bemar ibya nikad, degite ¿amba be aku dakmarde? Uayade bemar nikmarbalid, degite ¿amba bemar aku itomarbarde? ¿Bemar insasursi,
dule-miliatar-abargi madu-gwaataled an mimmisgu, garba-gwabigwa deun bemar madu-obichad wesmala? E-sapingan, abin-sogdemalad: —Garba gwaambe-gakabo.
Jesús sogdebalid: —Dule-milibaked-abargi madu-gwagugled an mimmisbargu, ¿Garba-gwabigwa ade bemar wesmarbali? E-sapingan, abin-sogdemalad: —Garba gwagugle.
Geb degi Jesús na e-sapinganga sogdesunnad: —Degite ¿amba bemar aku-itomarde, ibi an bemarga obare? Nue aku an be-dakmalad.
Jesús Betsaidagi dule-aku-ataked nudaksad
Geb degi Jesús Betsaidase nonibarsun, agi dule-wargwen aku-ataked ese senonimalad. Geb Jesúsgi wilenagusmalad, ebugegar, adi nudakegar.
Jesús dule-aku-ataked argangi gasgu, neggweburgi ega banguded. Geb Jesús dule-aku-ataked ibyagi wiaksagu, e-argan dulegi mesis imaksad, geb degi ese egichidsunnad: —¿Emigindi sunna mag be dake?
Dule-aku-ataked atakdegu, sogded: —Dulemar an daked, sapimar nanaeyob.
Jesús gannar na e-argan dule-aku-ataked-e-ibyagi mesisgu, dule nue-nuu atakdegu, nue nugusad, degisoggu, nue-swilidik atakdesunnad.
Jesús dule-nudaksad-sorba, negse dule-nugusad-barmisad, ega sogded: —Mer neggweburse be doggwelo, be-negse be nadegugwelo, degine, mer dulemarga sogbalo be nugusad.
Pedro Jesúsga sogsad, be Bab-Dummad-Machi-sunnadye
A-sorbali Jesús, degi, e-sapingan, neggwebur-burwigana Cesarea-de-Filipos-yargi-siidse, nade-gusmalad. Igarba-nadapi, Jesús, e-sapinganse egichialid: —¿Doaye dulemar an-nik sogmala?

E-sapingan, abin-sogdemalad: —Gwenna-gwenna Juan-Bautistaye be-nik sogmalad. Baigandi sogmalad, be Bab-Dummad-gaya-burba-berbeged, Elías-nugadye. Agi baigan sogmarbalid, be Bab-Dummad-gaya-burba-berbeged-gudigusad-wargwenye.
Jesús na e-sapinganga sogded: —¿Bemardina, doaye an-nik sogmarmosunna? Pedro, Jesús-abin sogded: —Be Mesías. (A sogleged, Bab Dummad epenne dule-wargwen barmidagoye-sogsad-duleye.)
Geb degi Jesús na e-sapinganga binnasur sogdesunnad: “Melle dulemar-baiganga bipisaar sogoye, ede Cristoye, Bab-Dummad-dule-wargwen-barmidagoye-sogsad-dule-sunnadye.”
Jesús na e-burgoedgi sunmaksad

Degi Jesús, e-sapingan-odurdakded, sogded: —Ani Dule-Machi, nue wileger-gebed. Judiomar-girmar-dummagan, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad-e-dummagan, degine, escribamar, amar gwen an-abingaosurmalad, an-oburgwemaloed. Geb degine, ibapaagi gannar an durgubaloed.
Jesús wegi-ibmar-sogsadi e-sapinganga ise-bakar-bud sogsado, ede oburgwilegoye. Agi Pedro, Jesús-bachikii-sesgua, ega binnasur sogded: —Mer deyob be soge, an burgoye.
Jesús aibilisgu, e-sapingan-bela dakdegu, geb Pedroga sabsur sogded: —Nia-saila-Satanás be angi bangusun. Bab-Dummad-sunnaa be binsasulid, unnila dulemar-sunnaa be binsaed.

Geb degi Jesús dulemar-baiganse gochabargu, na e-sapinganga, degine, dulemar-baiganga sogded: “Ar dule-gwensak an-sapinga gubiele, na dukin san-ieger-gebed, nakrus-semaiyob nanaer-gebed, bato burgwenadapidyob, geb a-dule anba dagodo, geb a an-sapinga guodo.
“Ar dule wargwen anba-naid-ular burgwebisulir, e-san-burba ei yogguodo. Ar anba-naid-ular, degi, an-gaya-burba-nued-ular, agi burgwenonikirdi, adi na e-san-burba yogguosurdo.
“¿Ar ibi-nuedga dule-wargwenga gusar be insae, a-dule napneg-naid bela egadga imaksar, ar e-san-burbadi yoggusar?
Aginbali, ¿dule-gwensak e-san-burba-ular ibi na uksar be insae, adi e-san-burba mer ei yogguegar? Ibmar sated, san-burba-ular ogwaed.

“Dule-gwensak neg-sichigi-galagwensuli-yolemaladyob Bab-Dummadgi-nodimalad-abargi, degi, we-dulemar-iskudimalad-abargi, an-nug-ular, degi, an-gaya-burba-nued-ular bingegusale, degi, an-osulosale, ani Dule-Machi, an-angermar-gwage-swilidikmalad-abargi, an Bab-Dummad-ganguedgi, degi, nue-yeer-dakleged-nikadgi, an danikir, an we-dulegi bingegumogoed, aku-dakye an egi sogmogoed.”
